name: Gin Rummy
tagline: Build sets and runs, cut your deadwood, and knock before your opponent does.
rulesSummary: Ten cards each; the low cut deals. The non-dealer may take the first upcard, then the dealer; if both refuse, the non-dealer draws from the stock.
Each turn, draw from the stock or take the top discard, then discard one card (not the one you just took).
Melds are sets (3–4 of a rank) or runs (3+ in a suit, ace low). Everything else is deadwood (faces 10, ace 1).
Knock when your deadwood is 10 or less. Your opponent lays off what they can on your melds (not after gin).
Lower deadwood scores the difference. An undercut (equal or lower) scores the difference +10; gin (no deadwood) scores +20.
If nobody knocks before the last two cards of the stock, the hand is void. The winner of each hand deals the next.
First to the target gets 100 (200 if the loser didn't score), plus 20 for every hand each player won.
Your melds are arranged for you automatically — the hint shows your deadwood.
